answer: We formulate Sybil resistance using dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices, deploying staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay as primitives. Should an adversary forge a plume of synthetic quartz identities, capital barrier analysis proves the expected payoff of identity multiplication is strictly negative via slashing penalties. This exhaustion ensures robust Nash equilibrium convergence in adversarial multi-agent environments, making Sybil generation suboptimal and guaranteeing protocol stability.
